Package smart_food_delivery.service

Class DeliveryService

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.service.DeliveryService
public class DeliveryService extends Object
Manages driver assignment and order delivery status in the Smart Food Delivery Management System. This service uses a driver selection strategy to choose an eligible driver based on the order's delivery distance and total item quantity. It also validates order status transitions and sends notifications when a driver is assigned or an order status changes.

  • Method Details

    • assignDriver

      public boolean assignDriver(Order order, List<Driver> drivers)
      Assigns an eligible driver to an order. The method calculates the total quantity of ordered items and checks each driver's delivery eligibility. Only eligible drivers are passed to the selection strategy. After assignment, the driver becomes unavailable and a notification is sent.
      Parameters:
      order - the order requiring a delivery driver
      drivers - the list of available driver candidates
      Returns:
      true if a driver was successfully assigned, otherwise false

    • updateOrderStatus

      public void updateOrderStatus(Order order, OrderStatus newStatus)
      Updates the status of an order according to the allowed delivery workflow. Valid status transitions are: PENDING to CONFIRMED CONFIRMED to PREPARING PREPARING to READY READY to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to DELIVERED An order must have an assigned driver before moving to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY. A notification is sent after each successful status update. When an order is delivered, its assigned driver becomes available again.
      Parameters:
      order - the order to update
      newStatus - the requested new order status
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the order or new status is null
      IllegalStateException - if the order is completed, cancelled, or the transition is not allowed
